supervisor_source:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$r='D:\论文复现\experiments\local_structure_wave2_20260930'
$source=Join-Path $r 'src\PaddleSeg-2.10.0'
$python='C:\Users\user\算法实验\venv_bisenet\Scripts\python.exe'
$env:PYTHONPATH=$source
$env:PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8'
$env:PYTHONUTF8='1'
$started=(Get-Date).ToString('o')
@{status='training';current='C2b';completed=@('C1b_artifacts_verified_exit_unknown');started_at=$started;runner_pid=$PID;test_used=$false}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $r 'results\queue_state.json') -Encoding UTF8
try {
  & $python (Join-Path $source 'tools\train.py') --config (Join-Path $r 'configs\C2b.yml') --save_dir (Join-Path $r 'training\C2b') --save_interval 1000 --log_iters 100 --keep_checkpoint_max 2 --seed 42 --num_workers 0 --use_ema --do_eval --device gpu --precision fp32
  $code=$LASTEXITCODE
  if($null -eq $code){throw 'Direct native command returned no LASTEXITCODE'}
  @{variant='C2b';started_at=$started;ended_at=(Get-Date).ToString('o');exit_code=$code;test_used=$false;runner_pid=$PID}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $r 'results\C2b_exit.json') -Encoding UTF8
  if($code -ne 0){throw "C2b train exit code $code"}
  @{status='training_finished_awaiting_validation_audit';completed=@('C1b_artifacts_verified_exit_unknown','C2b');ended_at=(Get-Date).ToString('o');test_used=$false}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $r 'results\queue_state.json') -Encoding UTF8
  exit 0
} catch {
  @{status='failed';current='C2b';error=$_.Exception.Message;updated_at=(Get-Date).ToString('o');test_used=$false}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $r 'results\queue_state.json') -Encoding UTF8
  exit 1
}
